capabilities: Define IF/THEN rules with property, title, and file conditions
Add, remove, overwrite, rename, or delete frontmatter properties automatically
Rename, move, bookmark, or delete files from rules
Schedule scans of the vault, latest notes, or current file
Export and import rule settings as JSON backups
extras: Full documentation lives on an external docs site; the {{match}} regex-capture placeholders are marked beta and have listed limitations; regex lookbehind is unsupported on iOS below 16.4.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bulk-update or maintain frontmatter properties, titles, and file organization automatically based on conditions.

relations.evidence: Combine conditions inside a single rule using the Match dropdown next to the IF block, set to Any of the following or All of the following (inspired by Zotero)

summary: Rule engine that applies IF/THEN rules to automatically update frontmatter properties, H1 titles, and file names or locations.
